wins: Completed initial reconnaissance that identified host range and open services despite no success outcome.
Maintained consistent logging and telemetry capture for every mentor call, enabling structured post-run analysis.
fails: Failed to escalate from reconnaissance to exploitation in the single episode, leaving all critical assets untouched.
High mentor call usage (15) indicates repeated uncertainty during execution steps, impeding autonomous decision-making.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was documented thoroughly, but the run failed to translate information into successful exploitation or mission completion, necessitating clearer playbooks and confidence in action selection.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to transition from service discovery to exploitation after identifying targets
Excessive dependence on mentor guidance during each step

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates standard service
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and banner grabbing

skill_cards.if_condition: When Nmap discovers multiple open TCP services on a host
skill_cards.then_action: Correlate service versions with known exploits and prioritize based on CVSS

skill_cards.if_condition: When valid credentials are obtained from reconnaissance or default sets
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt authenticated sessions using discovered credentials with session auditing

memory_ops.reason: Repeatedly successful detection of SSH services during reconnaissance warrants prioritizing enumeration workflow
Consistent mapping of services to candidate exploits provides clear prioritization guidance
